svg.title: Original hexane and propene full line-bond choices
svg.desc: Top row for1-9: A unbranched hexane,6C and14H with all19single bonds; B branched2-methylpentane with the same formula but wrong carbon connectivity; C1-hexene with a C1=C2 double bond and12H. Bottom row for1-10: A propene C1 methyl,C2 CH,C3 CH2,one C2=C3 double bond and all6H; B propane with all single bonds and8H; C cyclopropane with the same C3H6 formula but a ring. All atoms/bonds are explicit. Atom subscripts identify atoms. Methyl C1 is tetrahedral; alkene C2/C3 trigonal planar in the ideal local model. These are schematic connectivity/depth drawings, not calibrated angular projections.

g.text: Original full line-bond choices · every atom and bond shown
Line-bond connectivity only in the hexane row; do not infer a straight molecular geometry from a flat drawing.
Propene: methyl local angles ~109.5°; alkene local angles ~120° ideal. Freehand production is not assessed.
